run.question: Which subjects do Swedish party leaders speak about in the party-leader debates, grouped by topic similarity (not by opinion)?
run.corpus: Riksdag party-leader debates 1993-2026 (108 debates, 10,148 speeches), passages of whole sentences closed at 80 words (min 40, max 150); public parliamentary record
run.label: sbert-party

pipeline.map: 2-D UMAP of the representation (15 neighbours, min_dist 0.1, seed 10)

limitations: Topic similarity is not opinion similarity: a group says passages talk about a similar subject, not that speakers agree.

Refitted on the evaluation half of the debates (whole debates), without the published consensus, merge and noise-reassignment steps and without the 10% largest-group cap (not supported by ml/experiments/fit.cluster).
Group terms are generated by c-TF-IDF and unreviewed.
Local run: This run passed every criterion and was promoted. Both runner runs (Actions runs 41026327146 and 41073947884) rejected it on "a measured gain".

map.method: 2-D UMAP of the representation (15 neighbours, min_dist 0.1, seed 10)
map.note: Coordinates come from this run's own 2-D UMAP fit. Maps of different runs are not aligned, so a position or a movement between two maps means nothing.
